name: Invidia
source:
Aizawa Minami is a successful criminal psychologist. One day, she is asked to take on the case of a maniac who allegedly feigns insanity to avoid punishment. Initially, she views him merely as an object of research. However, as their communication progresses, she begins to realize that their interactions have disturbed some of the skeletons in her personal closet.
